info.title: Cosmetri
info.description: The API documentation helps you to identify API endpoints, Request payload and Response object that Cosmetri V1 exposes for authorised users.

put.summary: To regenerate access_token if it gets expired
put.description:
This endpoint revokes associated access_token with provided refresh_token and generates new bearer type access token for the user that must include in all subsequent API headers with Authorization key.

Notes: refresh_token will be valid till one week after expiration of the access_token.

access_token.description: Pass in header of further API calls with Authorization key

refresh_token.description: Use this token in oauth/token API with grant_type=refresh_token to re-generate access_token once it get expired after certain time span

created_at.description: Date time when the token is generated

access_token_expires_at.description: Date time when the access token will expire

refresh_token_expires_at.description: Date time when the refresh token will expire

post.summary: Get bearer type access token for Cosmetri APIs authentication
post.description:
This endpoint generates an access token for the user that must include in all subsequent API headers with Authorization key.

Notes:
  • access_token will be expired after 1 hour. By using associated refresh_token, you can refresh the access_token.
  • Only admin level user of professional account is allowed to generate the access token.

access_token.description: Pass in header of further API calls with Authorization key

refresh_token.description: Use this token in oauth/token API with grant_type=refresh_token to re-generate access_token once it get expired after certain time span

created_at.description: Date time when the token is generated

access_token_expires_at.description: Date time when the access token will expire

refresh_token_expires_at.description: Date time when the refresh token will expire

post.description:
A request to this endpoint will return raw material details based on the ID provided. Groups of values can be requested by including the ‘Tab’ parameter in the request. Currently, values from the ‘Info’ and ‘Cost’ tabs can be requested. If the ‘Tabs’ value is not provided in the request, it will only return the default values

For more information on the default values and fields under each tab, please check the ‘Schema’ below.

Field mappings:
'inf_id': '2511', Raw material ID
'inf_clone_parent_id': '2511', Raw material Parent ID
'inf_updated_date': '2023-04-14 12:27:11', Updated date
'inf_updated_id': '246', Updated user ID
'inf_created_date': '2015-03-16 10:59:28', Created Date
'inf_created_id': '246', Created User ID
'inf_trade_name': 'AQUA', Trade Name
'inf_cat_id': '44', Category ID
'inf_qua_status_id': '2', Quality Status ID
'inf_sup_id': '127', Supplier ID
'inf_moq': 'blank', Minimum order quantity
'inf_customer_group': '0', Customer Group ID
'inf_lead_time': 'blank', Lead Time
'inf_code': '7732-18-5', Batch No.
'inf_weight_of_liter': '1.000', Density in g/ml
'inf_current_stock': '999.950', Inventory level
'inf_loc_id': '45', Location ID
'loc_title': 'Test Location1', Location name

'category_label': 'Thickeners', Category label
